inventory.name: path-length CSS property (none | <number [0,∞]>, maps to SVG pathLength)

securityPrivacy.rationale: The property is a rendering-only rescaling of path computations; the spec change defines no security or privacy considerations and adds no cross-origin, storage, or input-processing behavior.

notes: Single-property CSS reference reclassified from stub to built per PR review (the page retains the full former-v149 reference alongside the MDN pointer). The value grammar and per-row definition table in #syntax are quoted from the svgwg patch; cascade/animation participation (outputs, lifecycle) in #effects; live inline SVG example plus recipes under #examples; availability and per-engine positions in #compatibility. Errors dimension is documented (not n/a) per PR review: #errors describes the malformed-declaration contract — parse-time rejection under standard CSS error handling with fallback to the previous cascaded or initial value. Errors distinguishes parse-time rejection of literal invalid values from invalid-at-computed-value-time var() substitution (resolves to the initial value, not an earlier declaration), and outputs (#effects) enumerates all three affected computations from the spec change: textPath positioning, motion animation, stroke operations.
